description: Retrieve PSC (beneficial owner) records for a UK company by company_number (from search_companies). Returns each PSC's name, kind (individual-person / corporate-entity / legal-person), natures of control (e.g. ownership-of-shares-75-to-100-percent), country of residence, nationality, notification date, and ceased date.

company_number.description: UK company number (e.g. "07098618") OR the company NAME (e.g. "Ocado Group") — a name is resolved here automatically and the match is echoed back as resolved_from_name. Pass whichever you have; do not guess a number from memory, since a plausible wrong one returns a clean empty result that reads as "nothing filed" for a company that may not exist.

name: get_persons_with_significant_control
